name: nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b-jordanian
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b: encoder max_position_embeddings 5000 (mel frames) with a 57-frame sliding window; the card's streaming config is 560 ms chunks at att_context_size [56,3].
attention_variant: FastConformer streaming encoder with RNNT decoder: 24 attention layers, hidden 1024, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, sliding_window 57 frames and subsampling_factor 8 (config.json encoder_config). Inherited unchanged from the base; only 10 h of Jordanian audio was trained on top.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.638 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence openmdw-1.1, repo created 2026-08-30.

benchmarks.name: Jordanian held-out test WER % (normalised, language tags stripped)
benchmarks.config: Card '## Accuracy' table '| | Base | Fine-tuned | Absolute | Relative |': WER 39.48% vs 28.82% (-10.66, -27.0%). 2,067 utterances / 3.32 h, never trained or validated on; same normaliser, att_context_size [56,3], batch size and GPU on both sides. Raw undecoded also wins (47.17 -> 30.10). CAVEAT: the fine-tune is 10 h of Jordanian speech, so this is in-domain dialect adaptation.
